name: Figure 03
summary: Figure 03 is Figure AI’s third-generation general-purpose humanoid robot, succeeding the retired Figure 02. Manufacturer-reported specifications include a 20 kg payload, 1.2 m/s speed and five-hour runtime, with measurement conditions unspecified. Figure has documented the robot’s arrival at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg. General purchase availability and public pricing remain unconfirmed.
specs_note: Commercial maturity PILOT recorded 2026-10-04 (owner decision, six-robot review). Basis: Figure 03 placed at an external customer site and a customer deployment agreement; no purchase or general availability is stated. Figure 03 is a separate, unpublished successor-generation robot to Figure 02 (figure-02); it is not merged with it. use_case_fits.notes: Figure reports the first demonstration of Figure 03 performing a parts-sequencing logistics workflow on the line at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg (Hall 52): two-handed picking and placement of parts into the correct slots while stepping and repositioning, and pulling a heavy cart down the line (https://www.figure.ai/news/f-03-at-bmw). Score 0.70 (owner decision 2026-10-24): on a par with other robots in customer-plant pilots. Figure 02's BMW production results are not carried over to Figure 03. HO-UC-01 evaluation (use_case_assessments/figure-03.json).
use_case_fits.limitations: Reported as a first demonstration under a pilot; no shifts, durations, volumes, success rates or robot count are stated for Figure 03. Figure 02's 30,000-car figure is not attributed to Figure 03. Purchase availability and pricing are unconfirmed.

use_case_fits.notes: Manufacturer design positioning: Figure states that Figure 03 is designed for the home, with perception for cluttered spaces, battery safety for home use and washable soft goods (https://www.figure.ai/news/introducing-figure-03). Associated, not rated. Editorial judgement from the manufacturer's stated design intent; not a demonstrated application. HO-UC-01 catch-up evaluation 2026-10-24.
use_case_fits.limitations: Design intent only: no home deployment, home pilot or consumer availability is recorded for Figure 03. The recorded pilot is industrial (BMW), not domestic.

spec_caveats.text: Figure states 5'8" (claim 48923025); recorded as approximately 173 cm (5'8" = 172.7 cm, rounded).
Figure's stat block states 'Payload 20KG' (claim b4da6ae2); the kind of payload (rated, peak, per arm) is not stated.
Figure states 'Runtime 5HR' (claim c3258260); the duty cycle is not stated.
Figure states 'Speed 1.2M/S' (claim 6e17a216); stated as the robot's speed, conditions not given.
Figure states '2.3 kWh enables 5 hours of run time at peak performance' (https://www.figure.ai/news/f-03-battery-development). 2.3 kWh = 2300 Wh (unit conversion).

Figure states 'Figure 03 introduces a next-generation vision system engineered for high-frequency visuomotor control. Its new camera architecture delivers twice the frame rate' (https://www.figure.ai/news/introducing-figure-03).

Figure states 'To make it easier to communicate naturally with the robot, Figure 03 features an upgraded audio hardware system for better real time speech-to-speech.' (https://www.figure.ai/news/introducing-figure-03).
